value.name: bc-authorize
value.description: This operation is used to claim a consent by the account holder for the requested scopes.

value.name: CancelInvoice
value.description: This operation is used to delete an invoice. The ReferenceId is associated with the invoice to be cancelled

value.name: CancelPreApproval
value.description: This operation is used to cancel a pre-approval. It is possible to cancel only that preapproval which is in approved state and the requesting Account Holder (Service Provider or Merchant) is the payee

value.name: CreateAccessToken
value.description: This operation is used to create an access token which can then be used to authorize and authenticate towards the other end-points of the API.

value.name: CreateInvoice
value.description: A merchant may use this in order to create an invoice that can be paid by an intended payer via any channel at a later stage.

value.name: CreateOauth2Token
value.description: This operation is used to claim a consent by the account holder for the requested scopes.

value.name: CreatePayments
value.description: Making it possible to perform payments via the partner gateway. This may be used to pay for external bills or to perform air-time top-ups.

value.name: GetAccountBalance
value.description: Get the balance of own account.

value.name: GetAccountBalanceInSpecificCurrency
value.description: Get the balance of own account. Currency parameter passed in GET

value.name: GetApprovedPreApprovals
value.description: This operation is used to get approved pre-approvals of an account holder. Only those pre-approvals of account holder, where requesting Account Holder (Service Provider or Merchant) is the payee, are returned.

value.name: GetBasicUserinfo
value.description: This operation returns personal information of the account holder. The operation does not need any consent by the account holder.

value.name: GetInvoiceStatus
value.description: This operation is used to get the status of an invoice. X-Reference-Id that was passed in the post is used as reference to the request

value.name: GetPaymentStatus
value.description: This operation is used to get the status of a Payment. X-Reference-Id that was passed in the post is used as reference to the request

value.name: GetPreApprovalStatus
value.description: This operation is used to get the status of a pre-approval. X-Reference-Id that was passed in the post is used as reference to the request.

value.name: GetUserInfoWithConsent
value.description: This operation is used to claim a consent by the account holder for the requested scopes.

value.name: PreApproval
value.description: Preapproval operation is used to create a pre-approval.

value.name: RequesttoPay
value.description:
This operation is used to request a payment from a consumer (Payer). The payer will be asked to authorize the payment. The transaction will be executed once the payer has authorized the payment. The requesttopay will be in status PENDING until the transaction is authorized or declined by the payer or it is timed out by the system. 
 Status of the transaction can be validated by using the GET /requesttopay/\<resourceId\>

value.name: RequesttoPayDeliveryNotification
value.description: This operation is used to send additional Notification to an End User.

value.name: RequesttoPayTransactionStatus
value.description: This operation is used to get the status of a request to pay. X-Reference-Id that was passed in the post is used as reference to the request.

value.name: RequestToWithdrawTransactionStatus
value.description: This operation is used to get the status of a request to withdraw. X-Reference-Id that was passed in the post is used as reference to the request.

value.name: RequestToWithdraw-V1
value.description: This operation is used to request a withdrawal (cash-out) from a consumer (Payer). The payer will be asked to authorize the withdrawal. The transaction will be executed once the payer has authorized the withdrawal

value.name: RequestToWithdraw-V2
value.description: This operation is used to request a withdrawal (cash-out) from a consumer (Payer). The payer will be asked to authorize the withdrawal. The transaction will be executed once the payer has authorized the withdrawal

value.name: ValidateAccountHolderStatus
value.description: Operation is used  to check if an account holder is registered and active in the system.
